mapper.select: SELECT u.id,u.user_no,i.provider_uid,i.secret_hash FROM user_identity i JOIN app_user u ON u.id=i.user_id WHERE i.provider='account' AND i.provider_uid=#{account} AND i.deleted_at IS NULL AND u.status=1 AND u.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT i.secret_hash FROM user_identity i JOIN app_user u ON u.id=i.user_id WHERE i.user_id=#{userId} AND i.provider='account' AND i.deleted_at IS NULL AND u.status=1 AND u.deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE app_user SET last_login_at=#{at} WHERE id=#{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT u.id,u.user_no,i.provider_uid FROM user_access_token t JOIN app_user u ON u.id=t.user_id JOIN user_identity i ON i.user_id=u.id AND i.provider='account' AND i.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE t.token_hash=#{tokenHash} AND t.revoked_at IS NULL AND t.expires_at>#{now} AND u.status=1 AND u.deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE user_access_token SET revoked_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE token_hash=#{tokenHash} AND revoked_at IS NULL
UPDATE user_identity SET secret_hash=#{hash} WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND provider='account' AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE user_access_token SET revoked_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND revoked_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM training_session WHERE id=#{sessionId} AND user_id=#{userId})
